Question: Austin and Temple are \(50\) miles apart along Interstate \(35.\) Bonnie drove from Austin to her daughter’s house in Temple, averaging \(60\) miles per hour. Leaving the car with her daughter, Bonnie rode a bus back to Austin along the same route and averaged \(40\) miles per hour on the return trip. What was the average speed for the round trip, in miles per hour?
